name: @ladbabynpm/picc-permission-modes
description: Claude Code style permission modes (default, acceptEdits, plan, bypassPermissions, auto) and user-defined permission rules for the pi coding agent. A more faithful port of Claude Code's harness than pi-permission-modes.
